frequency_question: What proportion of major contested legislative proposals successfully pass through all required Senate procedural steps and achieve final passage within 328 days of introduction or consideration?
membership_rule: Includes major partisan bills that reached committee consideration or floor placement in the U.S. Senate; excludes routine non-controversial bills, unanimous consent measures, and must-pass appropriations.

cases.name: American Health Care Act / Senate Repeal Efforts (2017)
Build Back Better / Inflation Reduction Act process (2022)
Border Security and Asylum Reform Bill (2024)

coverage_note: 5 named major contested legislative attempts with distinct procedural timelines; approximately 12 comparable major partisan initiatives in the modern era.
known_gaps: Does not fully account for filibuster threshold overrides or unique reconciliation rules, though standard legislative processes apply.
skeleton: Major partisan bills introduced in the Senate analyzed by procedural completion rate within session limits.
multiplier: 2 hits out of 5 named comparable major contested legislative pushes = 0.40
validity_reason: Senate procedural rules change slowly and remain stable across multi-year congressional sessions.
